> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-06-18

# Summary
Arizona localization of a Utah post on the signs of a hidden water leak: spiking summer water bills, running-water sounds, musty smells, and how Chandler pros find leaks without tearing up the home. Published 2026-06-18 at `/blog/signs-of-a-hidden-water-leak/` (ID 5781 in the June post list).

# Key facts
- Focus keyphrase: signs of a hidden water leak. SEO title (58 chars): "Signs of a Hidden Water Leak in Your Home | Summit".
- Money page link: `/water-leak-detection-chandler/`. Siblings: outdoor faucet leaking, signs of hard water. Reciprocal cluster links to `/blog/low-water-pressure-mesa/` (target 11 Aug) and `/blog/water-pressure-drops-multiple-fixtures/` (target 26 Aug) held until those went live.
- External sources: EPA WaterSense Fix a Leak Week; EPA mold and moisture guide.
- Seasonal angle rewritten for desert summer (irrigation, pools, evaporative cooling) plus a monsoon FAQ.
- Open caveat in the file: confirm against the content tracker that no other post targets this keyphrase.

# Utah flag
- Utah original at `blogs\_utah_originals\signs-of-a-hidden-water-leak.md` ("Utah pros" wording). Not for the AZ site.
- Featured image filename still `signs-of-a-hidden-water-leak-utah-home.png`; alt text updated to Arizona.

- `.md` draft and `.html` WP body; banner in `blogs\banners\`.
